LICENSE.md.summary: `LICENSE.md` defines the MIT License terms for the project, granting public usage, modification, and distribution rights without exports.

NudeNetv2/classifier.py.summary: `classifier.py` provides the `Classifier` class to download and run ONNX-based NSFW classification models on images and videos, serving as the core inference engine.

NudeNetv2/__init__.py.summary: This source file initializes the package by exposing `NudeClassifier`, `NudeClassifierLite`, and `NudeDetector`. It serves as the primary entry point for nudity detection and classification modules.

NudeNetv2/detector_utils.py.summary: This file provides image preprocessing utilities for the detector. It exports `read_image_bgr`, `compute_resize_scale`, `resize_image`, and `preprocess_image` to prepare images for model inference.

NudeNetv2/detector.py.summary: This file manages ONNX-based object detection for nudity using the `Detector` class. It downloads weights, processes images, and serves as the core detection module in the project.

NudeNetv2/image_utils.py.summary: `image_utils.py` provides utility functions for image processing, primarily exporting `load_img` to load and resize images into PIL format for the project.

NudeNetv2/video_utils.py.summary: `video_utils.py` processes video files to extract key frames using structural similarity. It exports `is_similar_frame` and `get_interest_frames_from_video`, serving as the video processing module for frame analysis.

README.md.summary: This file serves as the project documentation for the `NudeNetv2` repository. It exports and documents `NudeClassifier` to provide image and video nudity classification.

NudeNetv2/lite_classifier.py.summary: `LiteClassifier` performs lightweight image classification using an ONNX model to detect safe and unsafe content. It serves as a core inference component in the project.

fastDeploy_recipes/build_images.sh.summary: This shell script automates the creation, containerization, and publishing of `nudenet` classifier and detector Docker images using the `fastDeploy.py` CLI. It serves as a deployment recipe for building project artifacts.

fastDeploy_recipes/classifier/requiremen.summary: This configuration file specifies the exact `nudenet==2.0.11` dependency required for the classifier module. It ensures consistent environment setup for nudity detection tasks across the project.

fastDeploy_recipes/classifier/predictor..summary: This file implements image classification for the classifier recipe using NudeNet. Its primary function, `predictor`, processes batched images to return classification predictions.
